audit.whatIsWrong: Two fabricated ability names run through the content layer. 'Across the Sanguine' is used four times (whys[3], spikes[1].text, mid, wants.you[1]) for what is actually Across the Veil, and 'Twofold Movement passive' is used twice (spikes[0].text, early) — Twofold Hex is her Q and the passive is Spirit Abjuration.
audit.why: The kit file is authority on names. Neither invented name exists, and the second one also misfiles a Q as a passive, which changes what the reader thinks they are waiting on.
audit.corrected: All six occurrences replaced with Across the Veil, Spirit Abjuration and Twofold Hex as appropriate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every full-layer phases[N].side read "Skill" while content win[0..6] and packet.levelChart both read Neeko/Neeko/Neeko/Aurora/Aurora/Aurora/Aurora.
audit.why: The lane is even overall at 50.93% but not even stage by stage. Neeko owns levels 1-3: Aurora pays a flat 60 mana a Q with no dash charged, and Neeko's E reaches 1000. It flips the moment Across the Veil is available — a leap that ends in invisibility, on 22s at rank 1 — and stays flipped, because Between Worlds lets her teleport across her own zone away from a 600-range ultimate.
audit.corrected: phases[0..2].side = Neeko, phases[3..6].side = Aurora, whys rewritten to match, ratings realigned.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes said 'level 6 adds the ambush; Luden's makes the package lethal' — both stages belong to Aurora on this chart.
audit.why: Neeko's only spike here is level 3. Everything after it is Aurora gaining a way out of the root: the hop at 4-5, the ultimate zone at 6, item-funded resets after that.
audit.corrected: Level 3 root-bloom is the kill pattern; her hop takes it away from 4 on, and items keep it there.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no digit (defect 3). Across the Veil was named as matchup-defining without its cooldown, and neither Q's flat 60 mana, The Weirding's 15s, nor Between Worlds' 140/120/100 appeared anywhere.
audit.why: The hop is the entire matchup and it is 22s at rank 1 falling to 18s at rank 5 — a countable window in which she cannot leave a 1000-range root. Saying 'read it like a second minimap' without the number gives the reader nothing to count.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t now carry 22/21/20/19/18 plus the invisibility, Q at 9s for a flat 60, The Weirding at 15s, and Between Worlds at 140/120/100.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spirit Abjuration is absent from the page — the passive that heals her off every enemy she damages.
audit.why: The feed flags needs-antiheal. It is the reason chip poke does not accumulate against her, and it is why spending E on harass instead of on her step-up loses the lane rather than just wasting a cooldown.
audit.corrected: enemyWin now names the spirits healing the chip back; dontsFull[1].d leads with it; breakdown.late names Grievous Wounds.
sources: enemyKit P text and heal flag

audit.whatIsWrong: Aurora was addressed as he/his/him across the full layer — tldr, winCon, tradeGood, ahead, breakdown.early, breakdown.wave, dosFull[1].t, dosFull[2].t, dontsFull[0].t, report[0].t, report[1].t, report[3].t, report[4].t, report[9].t, report[11].t, report[13].t — while the content layer had her correctly as she/her.

Copy-paste bleed on four bullets: dosFull[0].d (title 'Walk the clone at trade range as a decoy') carried the hop line; dontsFull[1].d (title 'Spend the root on chip') carried the clone paragraph; dontsFull[2].d (title 'Disguise-engage without R ready') carried tradeBad verbatim; dontsFull[0].d was a name-swap template.
audit.corrected: All four rewritten to answer their own titles from Aurora's kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Placeholder phrasing: dontsFull[0].t and report[11].t said 'his setup spell' instead of naming it (defect 7).
audit.why: The spell has a name and it fits in the same space.
audit.corrected: 'Trade while Across the Veil is up'.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeGood claimed 'the full package is half a bar at level 3' — magnitude with no source (defect 6).
audit.why: No damage numbers in the kits. The real exit cue is her 22s hop coming back.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to the sequence plus 'leave before her 22s hop returns'.

audit.why: Whether Neeko's E root can catch Aurora mid-hop, and whether Across the Veil's invisibility can be broken by damage or revealed by a sweeper, are not answerable from the kit file. The page only claims she is killable while the hop is down, which is true either way.
